reusable_lessons.lesson: When calculating denial rates in claims analysis, use only adjudicated claims (Paid, Denied, Adjusted statuses) as the denominator to exclude pending claims which are not yet decided. Record the denominator choice explicitly in outputs.

For monthly claims volume trends, use service_date_from (when care began) as the date column rather than processing dates like adjudication_date. Service dates align trends with actual care delivery patterns and avoid lag-induced inconsistencies.
